title: InternBootcamp: Boosting LLM Reasoning with Verifiable Task Scaling
abstract: arXiv:2508.08636v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have revolutionized artificial intelligence by enabling complex reasoning capabilities. While recent advancements in reinforcement learning (RL) have primarily focused on domain-specific reasoning tasks (e.g., mathematics or code generation), real-world reasoning scenarios often require models to handle diverse and complex environments that narrow-domain benchmarks cannot fully capture. To address this gap, we present InternBootcamp, an open-source framework comprising 1000+ domain-diverse task environments specifically designed for LLM reasoning research. translated_title: InternBootcamp：通过可验证任务扩展提升大语言模型推理能力
translated_abstract: arXiv:2508.08636v4 公告类型：替换 摘要：大语言模型（LLMs）通过实现复杂的推理能力，彻底改变了人工智能领域。尽管最近在强化学习（RL）方面的进展主要集中在特定领域的推理任务（例如数学或代码生成），但现实世界的推理场景往往要求模型处理多样且复杂的环境，而狭窄领域的基准无法完全捕捉这些需求。为解决这一差距，我们提出了InternBootcamp，一个开源框架，包含1000多个领域多样化的任务环境，专门设计用于大语言模型推理研究。借助这些训练营，我们进一步建立了Bootcamp-Eval，一个自动生成的基准，用于全面的性能评估。评估显示，前沿模型在许多推理任务中仍表现不足，而使用InternBootcamp进行训练提供了一种有效提升性能的方法，使我们的32B模型实现了显著改进。
tldr: InternBootcamp提出了一个包含1000多个多样化任务环境的开源框架及自动生成的评估基准，通过可验证任务扩展显著提升了LLM在复杂推理任务中的性能。
en_tdlr: InternBootcamp introduces an open-source framework with 1000+ diverse task environments and an auto-generated benchmark, significantly boosting LLM reasoning performance through verifiable task scaling.
